segments.title: The tallest animal on Earth!
segments.say: Neema from Arusha, Tanzania, sees the tallest animal on Earth. Can you guess it?

segments.title: Which animal is the tallest?
segments.say: Which animal is the tallest? Three. Two. One.

segments.title: It's the giraffe!
segments.say: It's the giraffe! The tallest animal on Earth.

segments.title: Babies are six feet tall!
segments.say: Even a newborn baby giraffe is about six feet tall.

segments.title: Standing within an hour
segments.say: And it stands up within about an hour of being born!

segments.title: COMMENT BELOW
segments.say: Which animal should Neema find next? Comment below, and follow for more.
